title: ARTIC network
description: Wellcome Trust–funded project providing open resources, protocols, pipelines, software and training to enable end‑to‑end pathogen (primarily viral) genomics from sample to response.
keyFeatures: Virus-specific resource collections for EBOV, MeV, MPXV, and SARS‑CoV‑2.
Protocols for tiled amplicon and metagenomic sequencing workflows.
Nextflow analysis pipeline for viral amplicon data (amplicon‑nf).
Software suite for primer design, real-time analysis, phylogenetics, and QC (e.g., Fieldbioinformatics, PrimalScheme, RAMPART, PearTree).
Training materials including tutorials, guides, and workshop resources.
practicalUse: Adopt standardized viral sequencing and analysis workflows in public health labs; design primer schemes; run real-time analysis and phylogenetics; train staff with tutorials and guides for implementation and scale-up.
formatDetails: Website hub with sections for Viruses, Sequencing Protocols (tiled amplicon and metagenomic), Analysis Pipelines (e.g., amplicon-nf), Software (e.g., Fieldbioinformatics, PrimalScheme, RAMPART, PearTree), and Training (guides, tutorials, workshops).
